title: DynamicTanh: How Meta AI Replaced LayerNorm in 2025
description: Complete mathematical and implementation walkthrough of DynamicTanh — Meta AI's 2025 drop-in LayerNorm replacement. Covers what LayerNorm actually computes step-by-step, why normalizing statistics hurt training, the tanh saturation insight, how the learnable α scale adapts, comparison against LayerNorm/RMSNorm/BatchNorm, full PyTorch implementation, and ablation intuition.
venue: Based on Zhu et al., Transformers without Normalization (2025) arXiv:2503.10622
